Description: Because an employee may click a phishing link, the attacker might gain access to AWS admin console, resulting in data breach or exploitation.
Existing Controls: MFA For All Users, Separate Admin Accounts, and Annual Training
Action Plan: Require phishing-resistent MFA for admins. Alert on unusual admin logins.

Description: Because the AI model is trained on Bad Data without approval, the model might block real payments resulting in massive financial losses.
Action Plan: Restrict Training data write access. Monitor model accuracy and block rate. Define monitoring thresholds and an AI rollback runbook (see AI risk assessment)

Description: Because staff may share details in chat, merchant bank details could be posted in Slack, resulting in customer data exposure
Action Plan: Deploy Slack DLP to detect and block bank numbers. shorter retention

Description: Because the payment processor might have an outage, this will lead to block payments on Lonestar pay’s terminal resulting in lost revenue & Customer Harm
Existing Controls: Incident Response Policy Only. Vendor Risk Management Not Yet Establish
Action Plan: Collect annual SOC 2 and PCI-DSS reports. Obtain Cyber Insurance. Explore Backup Payment processors.

Description: Because a developer might commit secret code to github, this will lead to API_KEY being exposed resulting in unauthorized access to production systems.
Action Plan: Enable Secret Scanning with push blocking. Rotate exposed Keys

Description: Because an attacker can manipulate chat inputs, the AI model might expose another merchant data resulting in customer Data Exposure.
Action Plan: Limit chatbot data access to active merchant details. filter outputs. Carry adversaril testing and fine-tuning to only show the users data and restrict access to anything else. Prevent Restricted fields from reaching the AI model provider; create a chatbot shutdown runbook

Description: Because of improper offboarding practices, a former employee could still access systems and resources leading to unauthorized access.
Action Plan: Automate Okta deprovisioning from HR Terminations

Description: Because of misconfiguration or theft, merchant backup data could be released resulting in massive customer data exposure
Existing Controls: Information Security Policy, Change Management Policy
Action Plan: Monitor for public storage. restrict key access. log backup access.
